age.evidence: Our study included 10 adult patients (8 females, 2 males, mean age of 68.8 ± 10.6 years) with advanced hip osteoarthritis scheduled for primary total hip replacement.

cell_type.evidence: inferred: Additional samples of these biomaterials were incubated in the inner filter of a surgical suction handle device (BoneFlo®, TissueFlow GmbH, Essen, Germany) (BF group) for 20 min with the patient’s surgical site released tissue (blood, bone/bone marrow fragments, muscle and fat) collected during surgery.
